name: Testing
description: Frontend testing pyramid: unit testing with Jest/Vitest, component testing with Testing Library, integration testing with API mocking (MSW), end-to-end testing with Playwright/Cypress, visual regression testing, accessibility testing, test design patterns, coverage strategy, and performance testing.

subskills.name: Unit Testing
subskills.description: Jest/Vitest setup, describe/it blocks, matchers, mocking (jest.mock, vi.mock), snapshot testing.

subskills.name: Component Testing
subskills.description: React Testing Library, @testing-library/vue, render/screen/fireEvent, user-event, role-based queries.

subskills.name: Integration Testing
subskills.description: API mocking with MSW (Mock Service Worker), testing connected components, multi-component flows.

subskills.name: End-to-End Testing
subskills.description: Playwright/Cypress test authoring, page objects, network interception, CI flakiness mitigation.

subskills.name: Visual Regression Testing
subskills.description: Chromatic, Percy, Playwright screenshot comparison, baseline management, threshold tuning.

subskills.name: Accessibility Testing
subskills.description: axe-core integration, jest-axe, Playwright accessibility audit, keyboard navigation testing, ARIA validation.

subskills.name: Test Design Patterns
subskills.description: Arrange-Act-Assert (AAA), test doubles (spy, stub, mock, fake), fixtures, factories, test data builders.

subskills.name: Coverage Strategy
subskills.description: Statement/branch/function/line coverage, meaningful thresholds, coverage-driven refactoring, coverage gaps analysis.

subskills.name: Performance Testing
subskills.description: Lighthouse CI gates, Web Vitals budgets, bundle size regression, runtime performance benchmarking.

github.signal: Lighthouse CI or performance budget config

cv.signal: E2E testing with Cypress or Playwright
Accessibility auditing or WCAG compliance testing

linkedin.signal: Cypress, Playwright, or QA automation endorsed

junior.description: Writes unit tests with Jest/Vitest, tests components with Testing Library, and follows AAA pattern.

mid.description: Mocks APIs with MSW for integration tests, writes stable E2E tests, and integrates accessibility auditing.

senior.description: Implements visual regression pipelines, defines meaningful coverage thresholds, and gates deploys on performance budgets.
